title: Hate Speech Detection and Racial Bias Mitigation in Social Media based on BERT model

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the disparity in model predictions by comparing the classification rates of negative labels (e.g., hate speech, offensive, racism) on cross-domain datasets consisting of tweets written in African-American English (AAE-aligned) versus Standard American English (White-aligned/SAE).

Calculating Local Mutual Information (LMI) to identify and extract high-frequency n-grams that are disproportionately correlated with specific classification labels (e.g., associating 'islam' with racism, or 'feminism' with sexism) to measure explicit data-driven biases.
